day_shape: 75 items dominated by Lebanon front activity (IDF strikes on Nabatieh, Zawtar villages with 100+ strikes claimed, two soldiers wounded by Hezbollah drone), regime channel claims of a closed Strait of Hormuz and CENTCOM blockade posture, Rubio testimony on Mojtaba Khamenei and UAE/Kuwait cooperation, and UK Parliament confined to carbon budget statements.

threads.label: Lebanon front: strikes, drones, evacuations
threads.summary: The IDF struck Hezbollah targets across southern Lebanon including renewed evacuation warnings for Nabatieh, reported 100+ strikes around Zawtar al-Sharqiya and Gharbiyah, and a strike on a car in Toul; two IDF soldiers were lightly wounded in a Hezbollah explosive drone attack and two Lebanese soldiers were wounded near Nabatieh. Defa Press and IRIB carried Hezbollah claims that any ceasefire must precede full Israeli withdrawal and that Tel Aviv would be targeted if Dahieh is bombed.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US posture
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS Abraham Lincoln continues transits in the Arabian Sea supporting a US blockade of Iran, with 122 commercial vessels redirected. IRIB cited Senator Chris Murphy questioning Secretary Rubio about the closed Strait, depleted Patriot stocks and a $1.50 petrol price rise; Defa Press said the IRGC navy permitted 24 vessels through the Strait in 24 hours.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy and Rubio testimony
threads.summary: Trump denied on Truth Social that US-Iran talks had stalled, calling reports "false and erroneous," while Rubio told lawmakers Mojtaba Khamenei is "increasingly engaged" and the WSJ reported Washington is pressing Oman to break ties with Tehran. IRIB carried Rubio's reported admission that the UAE and Kuwait cooperated extensively with the US in the war against Iran, and Araghchi spoke by phone with Egypt's Badr Abdelati.

threads.label: Israeli messaging on Iran regime
threads.summary: Netanyahu told incoming Mossad chief Roman Gofman at his inauguration that he would "remove Iran's Islamic regime from the world," and separately said the system's foundations had "cracked." The Jerusalem Post reported Israeli defence officials expect stronger regional influence after the Iran war, citing Arab security concerns and rising Israeli arms sales.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and October 7 cases
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas Nukhba deputy commander Yousef Ayesh Awad Ramadan, who took part in abducting Hersh Goldberg-Polin, Eliya Cohen, Alon Ohel and Or Levy from the Re'im bomb shelter on October 7, and named five further operatives killed in Gaza. An indictment was filed against Ibrahim Hilo over the holding of Oron Shaul's body for nearly a decade.

threads.label: Iran nuclear stockpile and London plot indictment
threads.summary: Russia's Vienna envoy Ulyanov said any transfer of Iran's uranium reserves out of the country requires Tehran's consent, responding to the IAEA director-general's comments on their fate. Iran International reported US court documents in which an Iraqi-Iranian indicted over nearly 20 attacks in Europe and the US told the FBI he met Khamenei three days before the war.

threads.label: Regime domestic messaging and succession
threads.summary: Khamenei's office issued messages on parliament's role and on public solidarity, including donation channels for war-affected Iranians, while Defa Press announced three-day public farewell ceremonies for the "Martyr Imam" in Tehran, Qom and Mashhad. Ayatollah Makarem Shirazi was quoted saying inflation is the public's main concern, and a Leader's representative was dispatched to Hormozgan and Sistan-Baluchestan.

events.summary_en: Construction and launch of a vessel with 700-ton cargo capacity in Hormozgan. A twin-engine metal vessel 49 metres in length with a 700-ton carrying capacity was designed, built and successfully launched by relying on the knowledge and expertise of domestic specialists at one of Hormozgan Province's shipyards. This vessel was built relying on technical knowledge and the expertise of domestic engineers and specialists and demonstrates the continuation of the production process and development of the country's maritime infrastructure under conditions affected by war and external constraints. The launch of this vessel is a reflection of national self-confidence and the continuation of the Iranian maritime industry's movement along the path of growth and development through the round-the-clock efforts of specialists and actors in this field...

events.title: The IDF says it struck and killed five terror operatives in the Gaza Strip in recent days, "to remove an immediate threat" to troops. The operatives had planned attacks on forces stationed in Gaza, "in the immediate timeframe," the military says. They are identified by the IDF as: Salem Qariqa, a member of Hamas's Shejaiya Battalion who worked to build explosives and advanced sniper attacks on troops; Saeed Shamali, a Nukhba Force team commander; Ahmad Khallas, a sniper platoon commander in the Palestinian islamic Jihad; and two more Hamas commanders who planted bombs targeting Israeli troops.
